revisions.title: Retry policy — exponential backoff for partner APIs
revisions.summary: Partner API calls retry with exponential backoff instead of a fixed delay.
revisions.body:
# What was chosen
Retry with exponential backoff.

# Reasons and evidence
Fixed delays caused bursts against a rate-limited partner.

# Alternatives considered
- Fixed delay (current spec)
- No retries

# Impact and replacement
Replaces the retry line of the HTTP client spec.

revisions.title: Retry policy — exponential backoff with a 30 s cap
revisions.summary: Partner API calls retry up to five times with capped exponential backoff and jitter.
revisions.body:
# What was chosen
Retry up to five times with exponential backoff (base 0.5 s, cap 30 s, full jitter).

# Reasons and evidence
Fixed delays caused bursts against a rate-limited partner.

# Alternatives considered
- Fixed delay (current spec)
- No retries

# Impact and replacement
Replaces the retry line of the HTTP client spec.
